title: Windburst in Netherite Armor
description: Allows players to launch themselves up with wind charges even while in Netherite armor.
body: This mod lets players use wind charges to launch themselves high into the air even while wearing netherite armor. It keeps normal netherite armor behavior intact, but removes the wind-charge-specific resistance that can dampen that upward blast, so netherite users can get the same kind of vertical boost they would expect with lighter armor or no armor.
